description: This file defines a ViewModel class `WorkoutViewModel` for managing workout detail data and UI state in an Android application. It handles loading workout details asynchronously using coroutines and exposes LiveData for UI components.

classes.name: WorkoutViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel that handles loading and exposing workout details and loading state for the UI.

methods.name: loadWorkout
methods.description: Loads workout details asynchronously by ID, updating LiveData properties to reflect loading state and fetched data.
